## One more unaided attempt {.psf-lesson}

If you needed the hint or the worked solution, try this on a fresh line. If you completed the independent check unaided, select Next to compare or continue to practice.

1. Factorise $3x^2+8x-3$.
2. Expand to check.

::: {.fragment}

$P=-9$, $S=8$. The pairs $(-1,9)$ and $(-3,3)$ sum to $8$ and $0$. Choose $-1,9$.

:::

::: {.fragment}

$3x^2+9x-x-3=3x(x+3)-(x+3)=(3x-1)(x+3)$

:::

::: {.fragment}

Check: $(3x-1)(x+3)=3x^2+9x-x-3=3x^2+8x-3$.

:::
